clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Hammershout the Elder appears in Stormwind's Park. Travelers honor the old races and receive a ceremonial token from him.

During the Lunar Festival, revered ancestor spirits appear across Azeroth with wisdom and blessings for travelers who pay their respects. Hammershout the Elder appears in Stormwind's Park district. His presence near the heart of human civilization recalls the ancient races who walked the land before today's kingdoms rose.

Hammershout the Elder asks for no trial or oath, only acknowledgment of the past. He is relieved and grateful when people still honor the old races. In return, he gives travelers a ceremonial token, a sign of the bond between the living and the spirits who came before.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
